encoding.description: Encoding of the segment blob (e.g., jsonl+zstd, cbor+zstd).

file_digest.description: Digest of the exact segment blob bytes.

merkle_root_digest.description: Optional sha256 Merkle root over the ordered per-record digests for this segment. Leaf digests are `sha256` of the UTF-8 bytes of the JCS-canonicalized `event.record` objects as stored; odd levels duplicate the final leaf.

chain_head_digest.description: Optional continuity head for this segment. When present, compute `sha256` over the UTF-8 bytes of the JCS-canonicalized envelope containing `stream_id`, `segment_id`, `file_digest`, `count`, `first_at`, `last_at`, and any present `merkle_root_digest` / `prev_chain_head_digest`.

prev_chain_head_digest.description: Optional previous segment `chain_head_digest` for the same stream.
